title: Exponential Phi_fb — Ghost-Zeeman Homeostasis (Saturation Resolution)
author: Daniel J. Dillberg — bigdilly95@gmail.com
gate_source: EXP-403 Fork A [10]: forced (gamma_D=2.0, S_D=[2]*6) -> sat_ratio=0.60

operator.name: phi_fb_exp
operator.formula: beta_Z_eff = max(beta_Z_min_exp, beta_Z_base * exp(gamma_A * B_A - gamma_D * B_D))
properties: always positive: exp(x) > 0 for all x in R
fixed point: beta_Z_base * exp(0) = beta_Z_base when gamma_A*B_A == gamma_D*B_D
linearisation: exp(x) ~ 1+x for |x|<<1 -> reduces to EXP-402 linear form
no saturation at positive floor: max clamp redundant but retained for numerical safety
gradient dBeta/dB_A = beta_Z_base * gamma_A * exp(...) > 0 (amplification monotone)

equilibrium_analysis.fixed_point: gamma_A * B_A* = gamma_D * B_D* -> beta_Z_eff* = beta_Z_base
equilibrium_analysis.symmetric_case: gamma_A == gamma_D -> fixed point at B_A* == B_D*
equilibrium_analysis.asymmetric_case: gamma_A != gamma_D -> fixed point at gamma_A*B_A* == gamma_D*B_D*
equilibrium_analysis.EXP402_vs_EXP404_linearisation: for |gamma_A*B_A - gamma_D*B_D| < 0.1, phi_fb_exp ~ phi_fb to O(x^2)

saturation_comparison.exp_saturation_threshold: none (exp always > 0; floor hit only if beta_Z_base * exp(...) < 0.1)
saturation_comparison.improvement: saturation threshold moves from 1.5 (linear) to 3.0 (exp) -> 2x headroom

ghost_notes.Ghost_14: phi_fb_exp overcorrection risk: with B_A>>B_D (scene-structural), exp(gamma_A*B_A) grows exponentially. For B_A=4.81: exp(0.5*4.81)=exp(2.405)=11.07 -> beta_Z_eff=2.0*11.07=22.1. This is a 10x amplification vs EXP-402 6.8. Monitor leaf_count growth under exponential regime.

fork_A: phi_fb_exp(B_A=0, B_D>0) < beta_Z_base and > 0 (pullback, no negative)
phi_fb_exp linearisation: |phi_fb_exp - phi_fb| < 0.01 for |x| < 0.05 (small ghost regime)
EXP-401 regression: 92 leaves at cold start (beta_Z_eff = beta_Z_base)
sequential N=20: saturation_ratio_exp < saturation_ratio_linear for forced params (gamma_D=2.0, S_D=[2]*6)
sequential N=20 standard: beta_Z_eff* > beta_Z_base (B_A>>B_D amplifies more under exp)
gradient check: phi_fb_exp monotone in B_A (increasing) and B_D (decreasing)
fork_B: phi_fb_exp P_yz-invariant: beta_Z_eff_fwd(n) == beta_Z_eff_mir(n) for N=20 sequential
